title: Allow for smaller calendar widget on desktop
line: The Calendar widget on the desktop can now be resized smaller, and shrinking it far enough turns it into the date icon.
explanation: The Calendar widget switches to its compact date icon when it is smaller than 12 grid units, but its full calendar had a minimum size of 14 grid units tall (21 wide). On the desktop the widget can't be resized below its minimum, so it could never get smaller or reach the icon form; only the reporter's panel drag-and-drop hack gave a small one. The full calendar now has a minimum height below the switch size (and a minimum width that still fits the weekday names), with the old size kept as the preferred size, so shrinking it on the desktop turns it into the icon, which can then be made as small as wanted.

commits.message:
applets/calendar: allow resizing it into its icon on the desktop

The full calendar's minimum height was above the switch size, so on the
desktop it could never be shrunk. Lower it below that size, keeping the
old size as the preferred one, so shrinking it turns it into the icon.

BUG: 468765

patches.diff:
From 10d4776500425c588be43b95a1461cf652dec2ae Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:22:16 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/calendar: allow resizing it into its icon on the
 desktop

The full calendar's minimum height was above the switch size, so on the
desktop it could never be shrunk. Lower it below that size, keeping the
old size as the preferred one, so shrinking it turns it into the icon.

BUG: 468765
---
 applets/calendar/qml/main.qml | 10 ++++++----
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
index c536afd1ca..e18191d2d3 100644
--- a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
@@ -110,13 +110,15 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     fullRepresentation: Item {
 
         // sizing taken from digital clock
-        readonly property int _minimumWidth: calendar.showWeekNumbers ? Math.round(_minimumHeight * 1.75) : Math.round(_minimumHeight * 1.5)
-        readonly property int _minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 14
+        readonly property real _widthRatio: calendar.showWeekNumbers ? 1.75 : 1.5
         readonly property var appletInterface: root
 
-        Layout.minimumWidth: _minimumWidth
+        // Allow shrinking below the switch height, so on the desktop it can be resized into the compact representation
+        Layout.minimumWidth: Math.round(root.switchHeight * _widthRatio)
+        Layout.preferredWidth: Math.round(Layout.preferredHeight * _widthRatio)
         Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 80
-        Layout.minimumHeight: _minimumHeight
+        Layout.minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10
+        Layout.preferredHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 14
         Layout.maximumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 40
 
         Connections {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Dragging the corner inward: the calendar barely shrinks and stops at its minimum
Same drag: the calendar shrinks, then turns into the date icon and keeps shrinking
Growing the icon back turns it into the full calendar again
